registry.name: DisableCocreator
registry.description: Removes Cocreator, Image Creator, Generative Fill, Generative Erase and Remove Background from Paint. Everything else in Paint stays as it is.

registry.name: GeminiSettings
registry.description: Turns off the Gemini parts of Google Chrome through the policies Google documents, including the local model, history search and the AI entries in the address bar.

registry.name: AllowRecallEnablement
registry.description: Keeps Recall off on a Copilot+ PC. Recall takes a picture of the screen every few seconds and makes it searchable. This blocks both turning it on and the analysis behind it.

registry.name: DisableAIFeatures
registry.description: Removes the Copilot entries from Notepad, so Rewrite and Summarize no longer send text away.

registry.name: Start
registry.description: Sets the Windows AI fabric service to start on demand instead of with Windows. Features that need it still start it, they just no longer hold memory from boot.

registry.name: CopilotPageContext
registry.description: Turns off the Copilot parts of Microsoft Edge, including the page content the browser would hand to the assistant, the Copilot chat icon, AI history search and the local language model.

registry.name: DisableSearchBoxSuggestions
registry.description: Turns off web-based suggestions in the Start menu search box for privacy.

registry.name: DisableClickToDo
registry.description: Turns off the Click To Do overlay, which offers AI actions on whatever is on screen when you hold the Windows key and click. Selecting and copying works as before.

registry.name: TurnOffWindowsCopilot
registry.description: Removes the Copilot button from the taskbar via policy.

registry.name: RotatingLockScreenOverlayEnabled
registry.description: Removes Windows Spotlight ads and overlay from the lock screen.

registry.name: SubscribedContent-338389Enabled
registry.description: Turns off Windows tips and suggestions that appear on the lock screen and in notifications.

registry.name: Enabled
registry.description: Turns off the advertising ID used for personalized ads across apps.

registry.description: Hides the "What's new" and welcome experience after Windows updates.

registry.name: SubscribedContent-338393Enabled

registry.name: ShowSyncProviderNotifications
registry.description: Disables sync provider notifications (OneDrive ads) in the File Explorer status bar.

registry.name: Start_IrisRecommendations
registry.description: Removes app recommendations and ads from the Start menu (Windows 11).

registry.name: TailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticDataEnabled

registry.name: ScoobeSystemSettingEnabled

registry.name: SettingsPageVisibility
registry.description: Removes the Home page from the Settings app, so it opens on System and shows no recommendation cards. This value is a list of pages, and applying it replaces whatever the list held before.

registry.name: ShowOrHideMostUsedApps
registry.description: Forces the Most Used list in the Start menu to stay visible. The policy takes 1 for show and 2 for hide

registry.name: NoLockScreen
registry.description: Skips the lock screen and goes directly to the sign-in screen on wake.

registry.name: EnableSnapAssistFlyout
registry.description: Disables the snap layout flyout that appears when hovering over the maximize button.

registry.name: EnableSnapBar
registry.description: Stops the layout bar from dropping down when you drag a window to the top edge of the screen. Dragging into a corner still snaps.

registry.name: SnapAssist
registry.description: After snapping a window, Windows offers the remaining windows for the free half of the screen. This turns that offer off. The layouts on the maximize button are a separate setting.

registry.name: Start_Layout
registry.description: Sets the Windows 11 Start menu to show more pinned apps and fewer recommendations.

registry.name: BingSearchEnabled
registry.description: Stops the Start menu from sending typed search queries to Bing/the web.

registry.name: RightCompanionToggledOpen
registry.description: Hides the phone companion panel that Windows 11 opens on the right side of the Start menu. Same result as the toggle under Settings > Personalization > Start > Companions.

registry.name: AppsUseLightTheme
registry.description: Switches Windows and its apps to the dark colour scheme. The shipped default theme sets both to light, which is what resetting puts back.

registry.name: EnableTransparency
registry.description: Turns off the translucent taskbar, Start menu and window backgrounds. The surfaces become solid, which costs the composer less work on weak graphics.

registry.name: MultiTaskingAltTabFilter
registry.description: Keeps Alt Tab to open windows and leaves the browser tabs out of it, so the switcher no longer fills up with pages.
